title: Yeasty Indian Chicken Biryani
description: A crispy and flavorful Indian dish made with palm sugar, nam tan pip, and yeast, fitting for a Buddhist temple. This recipe is a Tamil twist on the classic butter chicken form.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 1 cup of lukewarm water, 1 teaspoon of sugar, and 2 teaspoons of yeast. Stir and let it sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add 1 cup of basmati rice to the mixture and mix well.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and saut4n onions until caramelized.
Add 1 cup of chicken breast, 1 cup of nam tan pip, 2 tablespoons of palm sugar, and 1 teaspoon of cumin powder to the pan and stir well.
